description:
This file defines a FastAPI router for legacy (deprecated) submission endpoints that serve as backward compatibility wrappers for data assets. It includes routes for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, all of which internally map to data asset operations. The endpoints are marked as deprecated and encourage users to switch to newer /api/v1/data-assets endpoints.

Key features include handling request validation, invoking services such as DataAssetService, ValidationService, and ApprovalService, and adding deprecation headers to responses.

methods.name: JSONResponse add_deprecation_header(response: JSONResponse)
methods.description: Adds HTTP headers to indicate the API endpoint is deprecated.

methods.name: create_submission( payload: Dict[str, Any], current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new submission mapping to data asset creation, accepts draft_id and user info, returns submission details.

methods.name: get_submission( submission_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a submission by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Triggers a validation run for a submission.

methods.name: approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Processes approval or rejection of a submission, including signature and SoD validation.
